questionReview.note: Linken final accounts and all nine adjustments on paper 2–3 correspond; trading/profit-and-loss 75 and balance sheet 45, scheme 3–5. No internal choice.
The six creditor errors, corrected control account 24, corrected schedule 28 and shared control/contra theory 8 correspond on paper 4 and scheme 6.

The six separately marked property ledgers (12/10/1/16/7/2), balance-sheet extract 4 and shared capital/revenue-reserve theory 8 correspond. The Irish balance-sheet extract moves from English scheme 8 to Irish 9; ledger pages remain 7–8. Both years and all transactions are required.
The complete tabular statement is one 60-mark task using paper 6–7. Scheme 10 is sideways and needs 90-degree rotation, as in English.

Five ratio/calculation tasks at 10 each, shareholder report 40 and Gener8 liquidity task 10 correspond. Irish paper 9 mistranslates cash sales as cash purchases in 5(a)(i); the Irish scheme explicitly awards all 10 marks to Irish candidates attempting Q5 (scheme 13). Both the calculation on 11 and the concession on 13 are retained for that correspondence.

Golf-club fund 30, income/expenditure 35, balance sheet 25 and financing evaluation 10 correspond on paper 10–11 and scheme 14–17. Financing options are an open response referring to the accounts, not a printed finite choice pool. Scheme labels the balance sheet (d), although it is paper (c).

All cash-flow tasks correspond: abridged profit/loss 18, operating reconciliation 17, cash-flow statement 48, net debt 5 and shared theory 12. The requests for three non-cash examples and two cash/non-profit items are open responses. Paper 12–13 and scheme 18–20 match.

Apportionment 26, reapportionment 8, both departmental rates at 6 each, job 925 price 22 and shared theory 12 correspond. Scheme 21–23 are sideways and need 90-degree rotation; 24 is upright. Alternative machine-hour workings on 22–23 are scheme alternatives, not optional paper tasks.

Both Dark and Bright products are required throughout production 12, purchases 18, manufacturing 23, unit costs 12 and trading 9; three open costing reasons share 6. Scheme 25 needs 90-degree rotation; 26–27 are upright. The scheme trading heading says 2019 although the paper budget is 2020; this is a source heading issue. No new task.
